label: late original-phase input of a/o/i/n/l/c/x/w after p/b/k/t/z/j/h/1-3
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase (99.9% of mass), never at t=0-1 or on <DEL>, and essentially never during copying. The rate climbs with position (orig_idx 2: 1%, orig_idx 8: 33%) and is highest on the last few tokens before <DEL>. It favors certain input tokens: a (24% rate), o, i, n, l, c, x, w; it is weaker on r, f, 0 and rare on others. It is boosted when earlier inputs include p/b/k/t/z/j/h or the digits 1-3 (the strongest examples begin with such tokens), and also on first occurrences (in_first rate 8% vs 1.5%). The activation looks graded, like a sum of position, token identity and prefix composition, so the boolean predicate tops out around F1 0.68 (dev mass recall 0.84). Adding more conditions (in_first, counts of A tokens, prev_tok) did not help.
